tools.name: get_ipo_gmp_today
tools.description: Live grey market premium (GMP) for Indian IPOs that are open, upcoming or awaiting listing: GMP in rupees and %, estimated listing price, overall subscription, dates, board (Mainboard/SME). GMP is the median of three public trackers, refreshed every 30 minutes from 7 AM to midnight IST.

tools.name: get_ipo
tools.description: Everything on one Indian IPO by company name: GMP and its day-wise history, price band, lot size, minimum investment, subscription (overall, QIB, NII, retail), open/close/allotment/listing dates, registrar, listing gain once listed, and a company profile (business, objects, financials, risks) with s

tools.name: get_gmp_accuracy
tools.description: How well the last GMP before listing predicted the actual listing gain for every Indian IPO listed since 2023 (1,200+): direction hit rate, median and mean miss, mainboard vs SME, by period, whether gains held after listing, and the latest IPOs.

tools.name: get_upcoming_ipos
tools.description: Indian IPOs with announced dates that have not opened yet, plus mainboard companies that filed a DRHP with SEBI and are waiting for dates (newest filing first).
